isolation: Reuses native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs: fresh temporary Chrome-for-Testing profile, owned CDP endpoint, verified released unpacked extension and actual SIDE_PANEL runtime context. No existing browser or profile is attached.
steps: Open Settings in the real native panel as an isolated guest.
Choose Dark through trusted pointer input; verify visible choice and persisted settings key.
Open Clear local data, Cancel; verify Dark remains visible and persisted.
Reopen and Confirm; verify settings key and prior session keys are removed.
Reload the panel; verify guest UI, System default, and no persisted theme.
